mathematical_object: Zero counts of concentric disks for the planar Gaussian entire function
scientific_integrity: Analytical proof of the exact covariance, bounded-offset asymptotic, and unique sign reversal; numerical checks corroborate but are not a proof.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed bounded differences of radii as the common radius tends to infinity.
No finite-radius sign conclusion at the limiting crossover gap, and no joint limit law.
The diagonal variance coefficient and the general pair-correlation ingredients are classical.
An implicitly equivalent offset asymptotic could exist in the broader Gaussian analytic-function literature.
title: A signed microscopic two-disk zero-count covariance law for the planar Gaussian entire function
